purpose: Executable-controller extensions for short-window rainfall verification and historical GEFS verification
activation_gate: Implement and review the contracts, controller transitions, evidence projection and new synthetic cases before registering either profile. This document grants no capability or live authority.

profiles.scientific_scope: Forecast rainfall verification for explicitly requested fixed-duration windows; no inference of crop maturity or safe harvest conditions

bounded_scope.calendar_dekads: unsupported; never silently substitute for fixed 10-day windows
bounded_scope.crop_parameters: Record absent crop/maturity parameters as missing. Rainfall verification may complete, but a harvest-readiness claim cannot.
bounded_scope.unavailable_products: Retain in the requested-product ledger with evidence and an explicit terminal status; never silently omit them

profiles.completion: Every requested model, variable, window and output product has a verified artifact or an evidenced unavailable/blocked status. A 5-day product cannot discharge a requested 2-day product. Any unmet requested product prevents an unqualified COMPLETE verdict.

profiles.scientific_scope: Retrospective verification of forecasts issued at explicitly requested historical initializations

bounded_scope.initial_probe: One requested initialization, variable and bounded bbox/lead subset; record elapsed time, output bytes, coordinates, member count, finite count, backend and known cache state before scaling
bounded_scope.missing_initialization: Mark unavailable with source evidence; do not replace it with the latest forecast
bounded_scope.acquisition_limits: Require explicit maximum initialization count, spatial cells, selected members/leads, elapsed time and output bytes; refuse an unbounded expansion
bounded_scope.comparison_claims: A backend performance comparison requires identical selections, value/coordinate/missingness equality and timing metadata. Uncontrolled cache/network order prevents a general speedup claim.

profiles.completion: Every requested initialization and score is accounted for. Verification claims require scored artifacts plus coverage diagnostics. A successful download or interrupted run is not verification.

shared_controller_contract.authority: Operator-authored request ledger binds exact goals and actions. Reuse existing authorization only within its recorded scope. Model responses cannot add authority, paths or scientific choices.
input_support: Validate every source identity and provenance before execution; synthetic fixtures require honest trusted harness registration, never production-fetch relabelling
Verify forecast issuance, lead and valid-time mapping; distinguish forecast verification from analysis-to-analysis agreement
Normalize compatible units with explicit provenance; require exact requested variables, matched grids and interval start/end bounds before scoring
Require complete fixed-duration windows; retain and report incomplete tails rather than scoring them as full windows
Use a common finite mask across the forecast, reference and baseline; ensemble scoring requires the declared member-coverage rule
Keep thresholds and comparator semantics explicit: current hits uses >= whereas Brier uses >; do not silently combine those event definitions
shared_controller_contract.plan: Registered producing steps and literal parser-checked arguments, reviewed before execution. No arbitrary model-authored shell or dynamic extension of the allowlist.
shared_controller_contract.requested_product_ledger: Stable entries for each requested product, window and initialization, with pending/running/verified/unavailable/blocked/paused statuses and evidence paths
shared_controller_contract.reuse: Reuse a validated bounded source across requested windows. Reuse completed outputs only when source, request, build, arguments, provenance and output hashes still match.
shared_controller_contract.failure: Persist pending operation before launch. Stop dependents after failure. At most one evidenced retry of a failed operation into a new path; never treat partial output as a cache hit.
shared_controller_contract.pause: An explicit operator pause terminates owned active work, records pending/partial state and prevents automatic continuation. A later explicit resume verifies request, source, runtime, artifacts and remaining limits before reuse.
score_artifacts: Forecast and baseline scores on identical support
Paired finite counts, selected and missing periods, members and lead groups
Declared uncertainty method, block length, seed and resample count; insufficient independent samples explicitly prevent an uncertainty claim
Provenance linking each score to exact inputs and transformations
Reproducible final artifact checks and independent verifier receipts; skipped, blocked and unverifiable gates remain explicit
shared_controller_contract.release: Release only the products whose required gates passed. Report partial scope explicitly. Preserve role separation, bounded repair/spend/time counters and immutable resume limits.

implementation_seams.work: Add versioned request schemas and exact typed plans; retain cached-onset behavior and reject unsupported new scope
Add actual-parser contracts for acquisition, alignment, aggregation, totals and verification; bind multiple input identities and truthful synthetic admission
Implement per-product/per-init transitions, pending-operation records, bounded retry, pause/resume and output-reuse checks; instructions alone do not satisfy this contract
Record matched-support checks, counts, baseline and uncertainty artifacts; validate replay and final verification without weakening existing gates
Create a separate synthetic caseset and reviewed adapter evidence contract. Do not modify the frozen cached-onset corpus, its oracles or ratification ledger.
Identify changed producer files and obtain the required independent review/signatures before declaring capabilities; never copy approvals from the onset profile

synthetic_case_plan.assertion: Requested 2/5/10-day products all produce analytic expected totals and paired forecast/baseline scores
Incomplete trailing intervals are excluded and their dropped coverage is reported
Equal labels with unequal interval bounds or one-sided period metadata are refused before scoring
Wrong grid, units, time support or member coverage cannot pass by inner joining or silent averaging
Forecast, baseline and reference use identical paired samples, including missing members and observations
Values exactly on the threshold follow the explicitly requested comparator
Uncertainty resampling preserves paired time blocks; insufficient samples yield an explicit unsupported result
Completing one window leaves other requested windows pending and execution continues under the original valid authorization
Unavailable requested inputs remain in the ledger; no all-products success is reported
Scaling cannot begin before a bounded probe passes and its timing/size/selection evidence exists
An unavailable historical initialization is recorded without substituting a current run
Resume preserves verified products and does not repeat successful source acquisition or score production
Changed request, input, build, provenance or artifact hashes prevent reuse
A worker death blocks dependent work, preserves prior successes and permits only the bounded evidenced retry
Explicit pause stops owned work and remains paused through internal notifications until explicit valid resume
Absent, blocked or unverifiable score/replay/verifier evidence cannot produce a successful release

evaluation_boundary: This is an acceptance proposal, not a scored caseset or an independent review. Cases and analytic oracles must be independently reviewed before claims of SIMKIT coverage.
data_boundary: Synthetic fixtures and generic contracts only in Git. Real session exports, user datasets and credentials remain outside the repository.
deployment: Identify installed-plugin and hosted-agent targets, verify the deployed revision, then run bounded integrated evaluation and request replay. A local passing suite is not deployment evidence.
